summary.intent: Resolve open PR review comments on a release-gate CI workflow, specifically fixing a bug where all-skipped jobs caused false failures in the fallback polling loop.
summary.outcome: Fixed two bugs in .github/workflows/release-gate.yml: (1) all-skipped jobs no longer cause false failures by counting only non-skipped active jobs, and (2) completed runs are now preferred over in-progress reruns by sorting completed runs first in the jq selector. Two commits pushed and threads resolved.

repo: release-gate.yml has separate fallback polling loops for Web and Desktop that share the same logical patterns and require parallel fixes.
The workflow uses jq selectors with [0] to pick the newest run for a SHA, which can accidentally select an in-progress rerun over an older completed run.
Job status filtering must exclude 'skipped' jobs when counting active jobs to avoid false all-skipped failures.

code.finding: jq run selector uses [0] (newest run) which can be an in-progress rerun; fix is to sort completed runs first so a completed run is preferred.
When all jobs are skipped, the fallback loop must continue past the run rather than treating it as a failure; requires filtering to ACTIVE (non-skipped) jobs only before checking counts.

workflow: PR review comments were resolved using GitHub GraphQL API for fetching/resolving threads and REST API for posting replies.
Automated reviewer comments (GitHub Copilot) were triaged and addressed with the same rigor as human reviewer comments.
Both Web and Desktop code paths required the same fix — a pattern to watch for in future CI workflow changes.

friction: The [0] jq selector silently picks in-progress reruns over completed runs, a subtle ordering bug that requires explicit sort-by-status logic to fix reliably.
The same bug existed independently in both the Web and Desktop fallback loops, requiring duplicate fixes.
open_items: No E2E tests were mentioned as run for this CI workflow change — coverage of the fallback loop logic under rerun scenarios may be absent.
The run ID query was also patched to match the completed-run preference fix; worth verifying both selectors stay in sync if the workflow is modified again.
